lcc_original: 對亞當【4】永恆主上帝則說：『你旣聽了你妻子的話，喫那樹上的果子，就是我吩咐你說：「不可喫」的，那麼土地就必因你的緣故而受咒詛；儘你一生的日子你必勞苦【5】，纔能從土地得喫的；
notes: 永恆主上帝 is LCC's expansion of the implied divine subject — no SN assigned since it has no Hebrew token counterpart in this verse
就是 assigned WH0834 (אשר); LCC restructures the relative clause as an appositive ('就是...「不可喫」的') rather than the embedded relative of UNV ('我所吩咐你...不可吃的')
LCC inverts the object/relative-clause order: 喫那樹上的果子，就是...「不可喫」的 vs. UNV's 吃了...那樹上的果子 after the relative clause — SNs for WAH04480+WH06086 are attached to 那樹上的 at its LCC position
LCC's explicit 說 absorbs UNV's implicit {<WAH09001>}{<WH0559>}{<WTH8800>} (לֵאמֹר) per Rule 3 — braces dropped
{<WAH04480>} for מִמֶּנּוּ kept implicit after 「不可喫」的, as LCC's sentence structure has no explicit 'from it' word at that position
土地 (LCC) vs. 地 (UNV) — both map to WH0127 (אֲדָמָה)
儘/一生/日子 distribute WH03605(כל)/WH02416(חַיִּים)/WH03117(יְמֵי) across LCC's inverted word order (life→days vs. Hebrew days-of→life); UNV compresses כל+ימי onto single character 終
Footnote markers 【4】【5】 preserved immediately after their attached SN tags
